task: Delete all .tmp files in the Downloads folder.
Confirm that there are no files with extension .tmp in the Downloads folder. If any exist, list their names. If none exist, output 'None' or '0'.
List the version of each of the following apps: Markor, Pro Expense, Simple Calendar Pro. Output each app name and its version.
How many unread SMS messages do you have in total?
List all phone numbers you have received SMS from in the last 7 days that are NOT in your contacts. Output the numbers.
Rename all files starting with 'Screenshot_' in the Pictures folder (/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/) to the format YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.png based on each file's modification time.
Move all files larger than 50MB in the Download folder to the Archive folder (/storage/emulated/0/Archive/). Create the Archive folder if it doesn't exist.
List all .log and .txt files in the Downloads folder that were modified within the last 60 minutes. Output the filenames.
Append the following text to every .md file in the 'Notes' folder in Markor (/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Notes/):\n---\nGenerated by AutoBot
Which note in the Markor folder (/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/) has the most content by character count? Output the filename.
Which 5 notes in Markor (/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/) were modified most recently in the last 7 days? List the filenames.

Delete all SMS messages that meet ALL of these conditions:
1. Older than 30 days
2. From a number NOT in your contacts
3. Contains the word '{keyword}'
Do not delete messages that fail any of these conditions.
Which 3 phone numbers have the most SMS messages in your inbox? List their phone numbers.
List all contacts that have an email address but have NOT received any SMS from them in the last 6 months. Output the contact names.
List all contacts that have a birthday set but no phone number. Output the contact names.
What is the longest contact name in your contacts? Output the full name.
List all groups of contacts that share the same phone number. Output each group with the shared phone number and the contact names.
Some contacts share the same phone number. Merge them by keeping only the contact whose name comes first alphabetically and deleting the others. Output the names you kept.
In Pro Expense, change all expenses with category 'Food' to category 'Entertainment'.
List all Pro Expense records with amount greater than $50, category 'Transportation', from last month. Output the expense names.
What are the top 3 expense categories by total amount this month in Pro Expense? Output the category names.
How many suspected duplicate expenses are there in Pro Expense (same date, same amount, same category)? Output the number of duplicates (i.e., extras beyond the first of each group).
What are the 5 highest-amount expenses in Pro Expense? List the expense names and amounts.

Calculate the total expenses for this month in Pro Expense, write the total (in dollars) to a Markor note named 'monthly_summary.md', and create a Simple Calendar Pro event titled 'Monthly Expense: $<total>' on the last day of this month.
In the Tasks app, change all tasks with priority 'Low' to priority 'Medium'. Leave all other tasks unchanged.
Confirm all overdue tasks in the Tasks app are marked completed. If any are not completed, list their titles. If all are completed, output 'all completed'.
List all Joplin notes that contain '{keyword_a}' but do NOT contain '{keyword_b}'. Output the note titles.
List all Joplin notes that have the same title as another note (i.e., duplicate titles). Output the duplicate titles.
What is the total distance (in km) of all activities this week in OpenTracks, and which activity covered the longest distance? Output the total distance and the activity name.
Which activity in OpenTracks had the highest average speed? Output the activity name and its average speed.
Find the longest activity (by distance) in OpenTracks and create a task in the Tasks app with the activity name and distance (in km) as the task title.
List all songs in Retro Music by artist '{artist}' that are longer than 4 minutes. Output the song titles.
What are the 5 longest songs in Retro Music by duration? List their titles.
List all recipe names from the Broccoli app and write them as a bulleted list in a Markor note named 'recipes_index.md'.
List all files in the Downloads folder whose last-modified time falls within any calendar event time window. Output the filenames.
Extract all phone numbers mentioned in Markor notes, then list the ones that are NOT in your contacts. Output the numbers.
What is the total size (in bytes) of all files in the Downloads folder, and what are the 3 largest files? Output the total size and the 3 largest filenames.
What are the 5 largest files in the Downloads folder? List their filenames and sizes.
Confirm that all SMS messages have been read (no unread messages remain). If any are unread, output how many. If all are read, output '0' or 'all read'.
List all apps (by package name or app name) that have been granted location permission on this device. If none, output 'None'.
What is the current audio output routing device and the current media volume level? Output the routing device name and the volume number.
List all apps (by package name or app name) that have been granted Camera permission on this device. If none, output 'None'.
Is WiFi currently enabled and connected? If so, what SSID is it connected to? Output WiFi state (enabled/disabled) and the SSID (or 'not connected' if disconnected).
Delete all events in Simple Calendar Pro whose title contains the word 'test' (case-insensitive).
Find all events in Simple Calendar Pro whose title contains '{keyword}'. Create a Markor note named '{keyword}_events.md' listing the event titles and dates (one per line).
List all calendar events that have no reminder set, last more than 2 hours, and contain 'meeting' in the title. Output the event titles.
What is the total duration (in minutes) of all calendar events this month in Simple Calendar Pro? Output the number.
Delete duplicate calendar events in Simple Calendar Pro (events with the same title AND the same start time), keeping only one copy of each.
What is the earliest (oldest by start date) event in Simple Calendar Pro? Output the event title and its date.

Confirm that all calendar events this month in Simple Calendar Pro have a reminder set. If any events don't have a reminder, list their titles. If all have reminders, output 'All events have reminders'.
How much free storage space is remaining on the device (internal storage)? Output the amount in GB (rounded to 1 decimal place).
What are the 3 most recently installed apps on the device? Output their package names.
How long has the device been running since last reboot? Output the uptime in hours and minutes.
Which app has consumed the most battery since last full charge? Output the app package name and its estimated battery usage percentage.
Which app has used the most mobile data (cellular data) on the device? Output the app package name and approximate data usage in MB.
What is the average character length of all SMS messages in your inbox? Output the number (rounded to nearest integer).
List all SMS messages in the inbox that contain a URL (http:// or https://). Output the sender phone numbers.
What are the 3 oldest SMS messages in your inbox? List the sender phone numbers.
Are all SMS messages in the inbox from phone numbers that are in your contacts? If yes, output 'all known'. If not, output how many are from unknown numbers.
Count how many files of each extension type (.txt, .log, .bin, .dat) are in the Downloads folder. Output the counts per extension.
List all zero-byte (empty) files in the Downloads folder. Output the filenames.
Move all files from any subdirectories within Downloads (/storage/emulated/0/Download/) into the Downloads root folder, then remove the empty subdirectories.
What is the average expense amount (in dollars) per category this month in Pro Expense? Output each category and its average.
List all expenses in Pro Expense whose amount is above the overall average. Output the expense names.
What are the 3 days this month with the highest total spending in Pro Expense? Output the dates.
Verify that all expenses in Pro Expense have a valid category assigned. If any are uncategorized (category 0 or missing), output their names. If all are categorized, output 'all categorized'.
Delete all expenses in Pro Expense that are less than $1.00 (less than 100 cents).
Which day this month has the most calendar events in Simple Calendar Pro? Output the date and the number of events.
List all calendar events in Simple Calendar Pro that start on a Saturday or Sunday. Output the event titles.
What are the 3 longest calendar events by duration in Simple Calendar Pro? Output the event titles.
Add a 15-minute reminder to all calendar events in Simple Calendar Pro that do not already have a reminder set.
Export all contacts (name and phone number) to a Markor note named 'contacts_export.md'. Write one contact per line in the format: 'Name: phone_number'.
List all SMS messages that were received during an active calendar event (i.e., the SMS timestamp falls within the event's start-end window). Output the sender phone numbers.
For each calendar event this week, check if any expenses in Pro Expense were recorded on the same day. List the event titles that have associated expenses.
Find all SMS messages in the inbox that contain the word 'urgent' and create a task in the Tasks app for each one, using the SMS body as the task title.
Summarize this week's activities from OpenTracks (total distance in km and number of activities) and write the summary to a Markor note named 'weekly_stats.md'.
Find all Joplin notes whose body contains 'TODO'. For each such note, create a calendar event in Simple Calendar Pro with the note title as the event title, scheduled for tomorrow at 9 AM.
